item.description: Octubre de 1977, un príncipe saudí consigue que un pedazo de hielo milenario viajara desde Alaska hasta una universidad situada en mitad de Estados Unidos. Para moverlo hicieron falta buzos, un helicóptero, un avión y un camión refrigerado. Su propósito era demostrar que la humanidad podía solucionar parte de sus problemas de abastecimiento de agua remolcando icebergs gigantescos desde la Antártida hasta los desiertos de Oriente Próximo. La operación reunió a científicos de 18 países y abrió un debate sobre una de las propuestas de ingeniería más extravagantes del siglo XX. Porque el hielo… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: When Jennifer Lopez helped launch a telemedicine network for children in Panama
item.description: In 2012, Jennifer Lopez and her sister Lynda Lopez donated telemedicine equipment through their family foundation to improve healthcare access for children in Panama. The initiative connected hospitals and health centres across the country with specialists at Children's Hospital Los Angeles, allowing doctors to seek medical advice remotely. The programme also supported medical training, specialist consultations and knowledge-sharing among healthcare professionals. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: France: Protests "brought the entire population together for a common purpose"
item.description: This weekend, in cities across France, some 800,000 protesters, including students, railway workers and members of the Yellow Vest movement, took to the streets in largely peaceful nationwide demonstrations. Sparked by a month of high school student protests over educational inequality and crumbling school facilities, the movement has grown into a broader outcry over the cost of living, public spending and climate inaction, as people across France say they have reached their breaking point.
